posts.title: Marvel Superheroes 2026 - Rumors & Discussion
posts.text: I love the name "category fraud" and yeah, that describes it well. Though I'd argue that John Walker supposedly being evil in TFATWS was category fraud to begin with. As far as I could make out, we were supposed to hate him from the beginning because he was a white dude who'd been assigned the Shield (when Steve had left the Shield to a black dude who'd then decided that the Shield belonged in a museum). If anything Sam and Bucky were opposing and obstructing him every step of the way, not the other way round. And the worst thing Walker did in the show was kill a supersoldier terrorist whose group'd just tried to murder him and had murdered his best friend in the process. Actual Avengers have certainly done much, much worse in the past (again the original Avengers included two SHIELD [which was secretly being controlled by Hydra] assassins, a weapons manufacturer, and a rage monster that casually levelled entire city blocks, and even freaking Wanda was an Avenger at some point!). What responsibilities? She's Monica's honorary aunt at best, and Monica is a grown-megablocks woman. We also see in the flashbacks that she did make time to come to Earth during the Blip crisis and check in with Maria, just not often enough for Monica's liking. Do you think any male hero would be considered unlikeable or irresponsible for not mothering another adult he's not even related to enough during a galaxy-wide crisis? That's just the MCU writers insisting that any female must be motherly, and not knowing how to write ones that aren't. IMO Carol's recklessness is her best and most intriguing trait. Occasionally this leads to catastrophic outcomes (such as the Kree apocalypse), but on the other hand she'd never have become Captain Marvel to begin with if she hadn't reacted to the Kree threat by shooting Mar-Vell's light speed engine. Saying "She's reckless and needs to be punished for it" is like saying Tony Stark needs to be punished for always running his mouth, which he did right up until his heroic death. That was me but I never said that Pietro was chaotic evil, I actually like him a lot more than I like Wanda. I got the feeling that even he occasionally found her a bit too vengeful - it would have been interesting to see whether they'd eventually grow apart if he'd lived. Though if I remember correctly the twins turned on Ultron because he set his sights on Sokovia instead of literally any other spot on the planet. That's a recurring theme with Wanda - she cannot stand anyone threatening what she considers hers, but anything she doesn't consider hers is up for grabs. All in all, however, I agree that there's no point in discussing characters' morality any further if the MCU writers aren't interested in following through with consequences for their choices. Wanda is a hugely popular character and thus we're supposed to root for her and her family, period. I don't expect Doomsday to give us any real closure for all the horrible things she's done in the past - I'd expect the focus, if any, would entirely be on her reunification with her husband and/or children. (Assuming all of these characters are in Doomsday to begin with.) Maybe, just maybe, there might be a scene with Wanda and America in a future movie where they have to work together and America's like "Wait a minute, aren't you the one that tortured and tried to kill me?" but I wouldn't even expect that. Meanwhile we'll probably never hear from Captain Marvel again, or only in passing, because the writers don't know how to write her and Brie Larson understandably wanted out. @Agent KallusWhere does it say that about Ant-Man in the magazine? My usual source for magazine content is Brickclicker, but I can't find it in his latest vid.

posts.title: Lego 12V/4.5 V connector patents?
posts.text: in the beginning lego used standard H0 style connectors / 2.6mm banana-plugs, see samsonite and 4.5v era lego trains, as a matter of fact the 4.5v/12v connector are still a standard 2.6mm banana-plug, although i think they manufactured them in house, most female 4.5v/12v connectors are rivets with accurate 2.6mm holes, i think lego cant patent these plugs because they existed long before lego adopted them also, fishertechnic uses these 2.6mm banana-plugs to this day! there are still a handful of online stores selling 2.6mm banana-plugs online, although most of them are for model railway and thus unreasonably expensive, same for fishertechnic also-also, here is a blogpost on diy fischertechnic terminals: https://www.whizzbizz.com/en/pcb-terminals-for-fischertechnik it might be relevant for 4.5v/12v

I still think the summer 2020 wave was one of the most boring we had in a long time, but it’s also the first time Lego had to adapt to a year without any films. 1HY26 had more playsets, but on average they were mostly quite ‘meh’. Personally 2HY wins for me because of the Remnant AT-AT and Sandcrawler alone. I agree. I think the best playset that came out of that year was a tie between Kylo’s Shuttle and the Anniversary Slave I. It didn’t help that outside of the Pasaana Speeder Chase, the entire TRoS wave was a retread of sets we either already got for TFA (Falcon and Shuttle), or further minor revamps of OT ships (Y-Wing and A-Wing). I vividly remember the wave being revealed and feeling quite disappointed. At least the Knights of Ren minifigures were excellent though. All six were genuine perfection.

posts.title: BrickCode Studio NQC and NXC IDE for Apple Silicon and Linux
posts.text: Hi Copernicon, Great to hear that 2.0.2 worked well for you, and thank you for the Mint steps! I’ve added them to the README, including your dmesg tip for checking that the tower is recognised and the link to the NQC install guide. The install section now lists macOS, Linux Mint, Fedora and Ubuntu/Debian, with a short status table of what has been tested and by whom. Ubuntu and Debian should work like Mint, since Mint is based on Ubuntu. A few answers: Syntax highlighting is fully automatic. The editor colors the code according to the mode (NQC or NXC) and the file extension, so there is nothing to switch on. Code formatting: I’m not sure which you mean, so I’d like your input. Would you prefer automatic indentation while typing, or a button that tidies up the whole program? The app has neither yet, but both are possible for a future version. CyberMaster: I don’t own a CyberMaster myself. I added it to the target menu to get feedback, and following NQC’s own logic it should work, but I haven’t been able to test it. I don’t know whether it needs its special green tower either, so if you try it, I’d love to hear the result. NXT: nbc is not in the apt repositories. I’ve added an install script for Debian/Ubuntu/Mint (linux/install-debian.sh) that builds nqc, nbc and the app, but it is untested, so I’d be curious whether it works for you. Your RCX examples: yes, please share them! You can paste them here or attach the .nqc files. I’ll add them to the examples/ folder with your name in a comment. The project is MIT licensed, so they stay free to use for everyone. I will adding soon the most used examples for Basic Robot with touch sensor, an arm, and others I found in the Dave Baum Guide. The updated README is here: https://github.com/JimBolanos/brickcode-studio Thanks again for all the testing!

If you choose to post fabricated information; you can expect to be banned! It's not worth the fifteen minutes of internet fame. This is for news and news only. If your post was on the boards, and now it's not...there is a good chance it was either hidden or moved. Off topic posts, placing info in the wrong thread, or a request from LEGO to remove something; these are all possible reasons why something may have disappeared. Thank you! Eurobricks Star Wars Forum Spoiler Policy With regards to upcoming sets and rumors: Read at your own risk. This is a topic about potential items to be released. If you do not see the movie or episode within two weeks, then you read here at your own risk. This is the policy in the Star Wars forum, going forward. posts.title: Modular Building Sets - Rumours and Discussion
posts.text: A newspaper press sounds like a great idea for a future modular especially since a lot of them are already built in an old-fashioned style. The Police Station already contains a newspaper stand, Detective's Office contains a smaller one, the newspaper part appears in Assembly Square, and newspapers are sold at the Corner Kiosk GWP. This would all make one tie in well. You could probably reference some of those other modulars with it. With how commonly suggested of an idea it is, they could have done one years ago. As I quoted above, they had also proposed a Shopping Street "with an aisle down the middle," but didn't go ahead with it as it was too difficult to fit in as many businesses as they wanted to. This ended up being similar to the one from 2026. If that was not a coincidence, I'm hoping in the same way there will be a printing press modular in the future.

posts.title: LEGO The Legend of Zelda - Discussion and Speculation
posts.text: Pfft. Fake fan. (j/k) Make no mistake, there is a TON of stuff in the Wild era that would make absolutely fantastic sets! The Divine Beasts, Guardians and Constructs, towns and ruins, the exotic foliage of the Depths, Stables, giant monsters. But there's a ton of stuff from other games that would be good too! I want the King of Red Lions and Tetra's ship. I want a Minish village. I want a modular Castle Town that can be tweaked to represent its various incarnations. I want the Spirit Train. I want excuses to include all the iconic recurring characters (and the fun new ones too). I love Ocarina of Time as much as anyone, but I don't love the extent to which it seems to dominate the fandom and be considered "standard" Zelda with everything else being an afterthought. The whole franchise has a lot to offer!
